players.name: Mbappé
players.bio: The fastest player in the game and one of the highest-rated attackers in EA FC 25. Mbappé combines explosive pace with elite finishing, making him a nightmare for any defensive line. His move to Real Madrid cemented his status as a generational talent. A World Cup winner at 19, he captains Les Bleus with the ambition of lifting the trophy again on home soil in 2026.

players.name: Dembélé
players.bio: A dazzling winger whose five-star skill moves and ambidextrous ability make him nearly impossible to defend one-on-one. Dembélé thrived under Luis Enrique at PSG, becoming the creative heartbeat of the team. His rapid acceleration and trickery on the ball give France a constant attacking threat from the right flank.

players.name: Griezmann
players.bio: One of the most intelligent forwards in world football. Griezmann's vision, work rate, and versatility allow him to drift between lines and create chances others cannot see. A 2018 World Cup winner and France's all-time leading scorer, his link-up play with Mbappé forms one of the deadliest partnerships in international football.

players.name: Tchouaméni
players.bio: A dominant midfield anchor who shields the back line with intelligent positioning and powerful tackling. At 6 foot 2, Tchouaméni combines physicality with surprising technical quality on the ball. His ability to play as both CDM and CB gives Deschamps tactical flexibility. A key component of Real Madrid's midfield engine.

players.name: Camavinga
players.bio: One of the youngest players to ever debut for France, Camavinga brings energy and defensive intensity to midfield. His ball-carrying ability and press resistance allow him to break opposition pressure and launch attacks. A Champions League winner at just 19, he represents the next generation of French midfield excellence.

players.name: Rabiot
players.bio: A tall, technical midfielder whose box-to-box range makes him a consistent performer for Les Bleus. Rabiot's physicality and aerial presence add a different dimension to France's midfield. His experience at Juventus and now Marseille provides crucial veteran leadership in high-pressure tournament scenarios.

players.name: T. Hernández
players.bio: An explosive attacking left-back whose overlapping runs and powerful shooting make him one of the most dangerous fullbacks in world football. Hernández's pace going forward stretches opposition defenses and provides a constant outlet on the left flank. His set-piece delivery and willingness to join the attack add a creative dimension from deep.

players.name: Upamecano
players.bio: A physical and aggressive center-back whose combination of pace and power makes him ideal for a high defensive line. Upamecano's ability to recover and engage in one-on-one duels complements France's attacking style. His partnership at Bayern Munich has refined his positioning and composure under pressure.

players.name: Saliba
players.bio: One of the biggest rating jumps in EA FC 25, earning a plus-four upgrade to 86 overall. Saliba has established himself as one of the Premier League's best defenders at Arsenal, combining reading of the game with composure in possession. His towering frame and clean tackling style make him the defensive leader of this French back line.

players.name: Koundé
players.bio: A technically gifted right-back who excels in possession-based systems. Koundé's ability to step into midfield and distribute the ball is rare for a defender. His pace and agility allow him to recover quickly, while his experience at Barcelona has sharpened his tactical awareness in advanced positions.

players.name: Maignan
players.bio: France's number one between the posts, Maignan is one of the highest-rated goalkeepers in EA FC 25. His Deflector PlayStyle Plus allows him to parry shots with increased precision and speed. An excellent shot-stopper with strong distribution, he provides a commanding presence that organizes the defense and plays out from the back with confidence.

substitutes.name: Konaté
substitutes.bio: A powerful and rapid center-back whose athleticism makes him a nightmare for attackers. Konaté's pace for a player of his size is exceptional, allowing him to play in Liverpool's high defensive line with confidence.

substitutes.name: Olise
substitutes.bio: A silky creative talent whose dribbling and eye for a pass make him a rising star for Les Bleus. Olise's ability to cut inside from the right and deliver precise through balls has drawn comparisons to some of France's greatest playmakers. His move to Bayern Munich signaled his arrival at the elite level.

substitutes.name: Thuram
substitutes.bio: Son of French legend Lilian Thuram, Marcus has forged his own path as a versatile and physical striker. His combination of pace, aerial ability, and link-up play gives France a different attacking option off the bench. His breakout season at Inter Milan established him as one of Serie A's most feared forwards.

substitutes.name: Samba
substitutes.bio: A late-blooming shot-stopper whose calm distribution and commanding box presence earned him a place in the France squad. Samba's reflexes and one-on-one ability provide an experienced backup option behind Maignan.

substitutes.name: Chevalier
substitutes.bio: One of the brightest young goalkeepers in Europe. Chevalier's shot-stopping at Lille has him fast-tracked into the senior France setup as a long-term successor between the posts.

substitutes.name: L. Hernández
substitutes.bio: A 2018 World Cup winner whose versatility across left-back and centre-back makes him an invaluable squad asset. Hernández combines aggression in the tackle with experience at the highest level.

substitutes.name: Pavard
substitutes.bio: World Cup winner in 2018 and scorer of one of that tournament's most iconic goals. Pavard offers cover at right-back and centre-back, blending technical comfort with defensive discipline at Inter Milan.

substitutes.name: Mendy
substitutes.bio: A defensively-minded left-back whose pace and recovery tackling have made him a Champions League regular at Real Madrid. Mendy provides a contrasting profile to Theo Hernández on the left flank.

substitutes.name: Kanté
substitutes.bio: The relentless engine room of the French midfield. Kanté's tackling, interceptions and quiet leadership remain world-class, and his 2018 World Cup medal speaks to a career built on humility and tireless work.

substitutes.name: Zaïre-Emery
substitutes.bio: A teenage prodigy who has already become a midfield linchpin at PSG. Zaïre-Emery's maturity, vision and box-to-box engine make him one of the most exciting young players in world football.

substitutes.name: Fofana
substitutes.bio: A physically dominant ball-winner whose move to AC Milan has accelerated his progression. Fofana adds steel and stamina to the French midfield rotation.

substitutes.name: Barcola
substitutes.bio: A direct, pacey winger who has emerged as one of PSG's most reliable attackers. Barcola's straight-line speed and improving end product offer France a fresh attacking dimension off the bench.

substitutes.name: Kolo Muani
substitutes.bio: A long, athletic forward whose link play and runs in behind have made him a France regular. Kolo Muani famously came inches from winning the 2022 World Cup final with a late one-on-one chance.

substitutes.name: Coman
substitutes.bio: A serial Bundesliga winner with Bayern Munich, Coman is one of the most decorated wingers in Europe. His acceleration and one-versus-one threat give France an experienced impact option from the bench.
